# M0 probe: results

**Not run yet.** This file is regenerated by `uv run python -m spikes.esef_probe --stage report`
and committed whether the probe passes or fails.

The thresholds it will be judged against are fixed in [README.md](README.md) and were written before
the probe was built, so the report stage only applies them.

| Assumption | Threshold | Measured | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 narrative figures resolve to tagged facts | 20 of 50 | not measured | pending |
| A2 browser boxes confirmed on the printed page | 90% | not measured | pending |
| A2 median IoU against the PDF | 0.5 | not measured | pending |

Until this table has numbers in it, nothing downstream of M0 should be built. If A1 fails, M4
reconciliation is cut. If A2 fails, citations drop to page level and the IoU metric is removed
rather than reported at a precision the measurement does not support.
